tests.description: Reference: NCAR fire_behavior (develop @ eb77580, default real32 build, gfortran 13.3 -O2 in the EqWeFiC container) running its test7 case (80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, num_tiles = 1), dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, c9dda02, -DESM_DUMP=ON; summary output bit-identical to the uninstrumented build). Single-precision source: rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract), abs 1e-7 where a value is exactly 0 or 1. Regime: cell (i,j) = (16, 60) at the end of step 20 (time_now = 10.5 s), a cell the front has just entered (fire_area 0.19, fuel_frac 0.9916, all ignition within the last steps); inputs are the 3x3 node neighbourhood of lfn and tign_g and the cell's fuel_time and previous fuel fraction from the fuel_left dump.

Reference: NCAR fire_behavior (develop @ eb77580, default real32 build, gfortran 13.3 -O2 in the EqWeFiC container) running its test7 case (80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, num_tiles = 1), dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, c9dda02, -DESM_DUMP=ON; summary output bit-identical to the uninstrumented build). Single-precision source: rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract), abs 1e-7 where a value is exactly 0 or 1. Regime: cell (i,j) = (17, 59) at the end of step 20 (time_now = 10.5 s), a nearly engulfed cell (fire_area 0.93, fuel_frac_before 0.947 already below 1); inputs are the 3x3 node neighbourhood of lfn and tign_g and the cell's fuel_time and previous fuel fraction from the fuel_left dump.

Reference: NCAR fire_behavior (develop @ eb77580, default real32 build, gfortran 13.3 -O2 in the EqWeFiC container) running its test7 case (80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, num_tiles = 1), dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, c9dda02, -DESM_DUMP=ON; summary output bit-identical to the uninstrumented build). Single-precision source: rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract), abs 1e-7 where a value is exactly 0 or 1. Regime: cell (i,j) = (17, 60) at the end of step 20 (time_now = 10.5 s), a fully burning cell (fire_area 1) whose nine node ignition times differ (6.8 .. 10.5 s), so the cell fuel fraction 0.832 is the mean of four different exponentials -- the case FuelConsumption's single ODE cannot represent; inputs are the 3x3 node neighbourhood of lfn and tign_g and the cell's fuel_time and previous fuel fraction from the fuel_left dump.

Regime: cell (i,j) = (16, 59) at the end of step 20 (time_now = 10.5 s), a cell the front barely touches (fire_area 0.023); inputs are the 3x3 node neighbourhood of lfn and tign_g and the cell's fuel_time and previous fuel fraction from the fuel_left dump.
